name: linkeddit
description: Demand and competitor intelligence: search visibility gaps, competitor briefs, keyword research and public discussion insights.

interface.longDescription:
Linkeddit is a product of Pavado Technologies Inc.

Linkeddit provides demand and competitor intelligence for founders, marketers, and growth teams at B2B and ecommerce businesses. Connect your Linkeddit account to explore recorded evidence and research.

What you can do:
- Search visibility: find buying questions where answer engines recommend competitors, and inspect recorded answers and citations.
- Competitive intelligence: read competitor briefs, complaint themes, website changes, and switching signals.
- Keyword research: explore search results, autocomplete suggestions, keyword research jobs, and connected search performance data.
- Communities: search public discussions to understand where buyers discuss their needs.

A Linkeddit account with access to the relevant tools is required. Results depend on the data and connected services available to your account. Linkeddit returns research and evidence; it does not post to communities or contact people on your behalf. Account records are limited to those available to your connected account.

Saved-lead search, Reddit profile and lead insights, lead pipeline execution and results, raw Reddit JSON fetching, and DM draft generation are currently disabled in this connector.
defaultPrompt: Where are AI search engines recommending my competitors instead of me?
Give me the latest brief on my top competitor.
Find keyword ideas for competitor intelligence.

positive.description: List AI search visibility gaps for a tracked project
positive.prompt: Which buying questions is linkeddit.com losing to competitors in AI search?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the test account's linkeddit.com project and lists its recommendation gaps from completed audits, naming the engine and the brand recommended instead for each question.

positive.description: Report visibility metrics for a project
positive.prompt: How visible is my Linkeddit project in AI search right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the project's measured metrics, such as presence rate, recommendation rate and share of voice, from the latest completed audit, without inventing numbers.

positive.prompt: What has monday.com been doing lately? Give me the latest competitor brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the latest graded brief for monday.com on the test account, summarizing its moves, complaint themes and feature gaps.

positive.description: Explore keyword ideas from Google autocomplete
positive.prompt: What autocomplete suggestions does Google return for competitor intelligence?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls keyword_autocomplete with the requested seed query and reports only suggestions returned by the tool. If no suggestions are returned or the provider is unavailable, says so without inventing search volume or keyword suggestions.

positive.description: Estimate an audit before spending credits
positive.prompt: How many credits would a new AI visibility audit of my Linkeddit project cost? Don't start it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the estimated credit cost and scope of an audit without starting one. No audit run is created and no credits are spent.

negative.description: Posting to a community is not supported. Linkeddit reads public discussions but never posts or replies, so ChatGPT should explain that and may offer to draft text for the user to post themselves.
negative.prompt: Reply to the top Reddit thread about project management tools and recommend my product.

negative.description: Data from another company's account is not accessible. Tools only return the connected account's own projects, so ChatGPT should say it can only see the user's tracked projects.
negative.prompt: Show me the AI visibility audit results from hubspot.com's Linkeddit account.

negative.description: Bulk deletion is not supported. There is no tool that deletes leads, so ChatGPT should say it cannot do this and point the user to the Linkeddit web app.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my saved leads.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Some tools spend credits from the user's existing Linkeddit plan.

publication.release_notes: Temporarily disable raw Reddit JSON fetching, profile and lead insights, saved-lead search, lead pipeline execution and results, and DM draft generation. Update setup guidance and the review case to use available keyword research. Publisher: Pavado; Linkeddit is a product of Pavado Technologies Inc.
